entries.title: Community Rules | Hynoe
entries.heading: 1. Treat people like people
entries.text: No targeted harassment, stalking, repeated unwanted contact, or coordinated pile-ons. No hateful attacks or dehumanizing abuse based on protected characteristics. entries.heading: 2. Protect minors

entries.heading: 3. Keep private information private
entries.text: No doxxing, posting another person's address, phone number, private email, government identifiers, passwords, tokens, private logs, or other non-public personal information without permission. entries.title: Community Rules | Hynoe
entries.heading: 4. No scams, impersonation, or malicious links
entries.text: Do not impersonate Hynoe staff, moderators, creators, or other users to deceive people. No phishing, malware, credential theft, fraudulent giveaways, fake payment requests, or intentionally deceptive links. Do not falsely claim that Hynoe, Mojang, Microsoft, or another company endorses a product or transaction.

entries.title: Community Rules | Hynoe
entries.heading: 5. Play fair in shared systems
entries.text: Do not exploit bugs, tamper with score submissions, forge public leaderboard results, attack APIs, or use automation to disrupt shared systems. Report serious exploits privately so they can be fixed instead of teaching others how to abuse them. Accessibility tools and normal client/device features are not cheating merely because they make interaction easier.

entries.title: Community Rules | Hynoe
entries.heading: 6. Content and spam
entries.text: No flooding, repeated spam, disruptive advertising, or content intended mainly to make a channel unusable. Keep sexual or graphic content out of Hynoe spaces unless a future space explicitly allows lawful age-restricted content; current general community spaces do not. Respect copyright and other creators' rights. Do not use Hynoe spaces to distribute obviously pirated or stolen material.

entries.title: Community Rules | Hynoe
entries.heading: 7. Moderation
entries.text: Moderators may remove content, warn users, mute/restrict features, or ban access to Hynoe-controlled spaces when reasonably needed for these rules, security, legal obligations, or community safety. Moderation decisions may consider context, severity, repetition, credible evidence, and risk to others. Do not evade a Hynoe ban or restriction by creating alternate identities or asking someone else to act for you.

entries.title: Community Rules | Hynoe
entries.heading: 8. Reporting
entries.text: Use the official Hynoe Discord linked from hynoesmp.com to contact moderators. For privacy, child-safety, threats, or security matters, ask for a private conversation and avoid reposting sensitive material publicly. entries.heading: The End is a checklist, not a shortcut.
entries.text: The major Story Ages can be progressed through their own milestones, but The End stays locked until every required Story Age is complete.
